result.title: PARC-Loc: Text-to-Point-Cloud Localization with Partial Assignment and Relational Consistency
result.summary: Text-to-point-cloud localization estimates a position in a city-scale 3D map from descriptions of surrounding objects. Existing coarse-to-fine methods retrieve submaps using aggregate learned compatibility and then localize within a selected submap. However, repetitive or similar urban objects can inflate the embedding similarity between the query and multiple submaps, even when the instance layout within a submap violates the query description. Meanwhile, query-relevant instances often span submap boundaries, leaving the retrieved submap with incomplete contextual evidence. We term these failure modes layout-inconsistent aliasing and boundary evidence incompleteness, respectively. To address them, we propose PARC-Loc, a coarse-to-fine localization framework built on Partial Assignment with Relational Consistency (PARC). PARC jointly models hint-object compatibility and pairwise spatial relations, allowing unmatched elements while favoring assignments consistent with the queried layout. At the coarse stage, its candidate-level assessment complements neural similarity for layout-consistent submap selection. At the fine stage, the context is expanded with query-relevant instances from adjacent submaps, while PARC yields object-level matching weights that guide cross-modal attention. Extensive experiments on KITTI360Pose and CityLoc show that PARC-Loc outperforms conventional coarse-to-fine baselines. On KITTI360Pose, our method improves Top-1 localization recall at 5 m from 0.50 to 0.67, achieving a 34% relative gain over the strongest baseline.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究城市级 3D 点云中的文本定位，指出聚合嵌入相似度会因重复物体产生「布局不一致的别名问题」，查询相关实例又常跨子图边界导致证据不完整，于是提出 PARC，联合建模提示物体兼容性与成对空间关系，允许部分未匹配，用于粗阶段子图选择与细阶段对象级匹配权重指导跨模态注意力。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽属 3D 定位任务，但「部分分配 + 关系一致性」以及对象级匹配权重可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与注意力结构提供可核查的线索：区分真正证据与相似度虚高，或对应 latent 状态中实体关系保留与证据选择问题。
